scripts.clean-webcomponents: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); ['src/sap/ui/geomap/gen', 'src/sap/ui/geomap/thirdparty'].forEach(d => { if (fs.existsSync(d)) fs.rmSync(d, {recursive: true}); fs.mkdirSync(d, {recursive: true}); });"
scripts.generate-webcomponents: npm run clean-webcomponents && npm run build-webcomponents
